skill_outcomes.skill_name: Conceptualization of demand for goods and services
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts, nature, and content of market demand and social consumption needs.
Understand the measurement indices and methods for forecasting objects in six specific areas.
Understand the internal and external relationships of forecasting objects in six specific areas.
Recognize influencing factors and mechanisms affecting forecasting objects.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analysis of past and current development
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and evaluate the development of forecasting objects in the past and present.
Analyze the impact of various factors on forecasting objects.
Analyze future environmental changes affecting forecasting objects.
Summarize issues, conduct qualitative analysis to predict future trends of specific forecasting objects.
Select appropriate forecasting approaches and models based on specific conditions and contexts.
Collect and process preliminary information and data for specific forecasting tasks.
Understand the method of building forecasting models and performing forecasting tasks manually without software.
Collect, summarize, analyze, and initially process necessary information and data for forecasting tasks.
Use appropriate statistical and econometric software to estimate models and perform forecasts.
Evaluate forecasts using appropriate statistical and econometric software.
Apply forecast results in management and policy planning.
Develop self-study and research skills to accumulate knowledge and improve forecasting practical skills.
Organize, supervise, and inspire team members in completing assigned tasks.
Have an awareness of professional ethics and social responsibility.
